UOS Sentinel - Aero UI Update
Feature List:

The Aero Interface
A high-performance GUI with a glass-blur effect. It includes smooth window dragging and a responsive layout that automatically scales to look clean on both PC and Mobile.

The Smart Scanner
Upon execution, UOS scans the game for Admin assets (Adonis, Kohl's, Cmdr). It creates a "to-do list" of these items so it doesn't have to keep searching for them, saving a ton of memory.

PC & Mobile Detection
The script checks your device instantly. If you are on a phone, it automatically turns down the workload so your device doesn't get hot or laggy.

The FPS Governor
It watches your frame rate in real-time. If your FPS drops, it slows down background tasks to keep your gameplay smooth. Once the lag is gone, it speeds back up.

Stutter Prevention
Instead of loading everything at once, the script processes data in "batches." This stops the annoying stuttering you get in big games.

The Sentinel Orb
A small glowing light in the top-right corner. It stays Green when performance is perfect, Yellow when it's throttling, and pulses Red if the lag is critical.

Technical Alerts
Get clean notifications with ✅ and ⚠️ emojis that tell you exactly what the engine is doing, like when it’s restoring stability.

Automatic Memory Cleanup
If a part or script is deleted by the game, UOS removes it from its list immediately so it doesn't waste energy on things that aren't there anymore.

Developer Console Logs
Every 10 seconds, the script prints a report in the F9 console showing your average FPS and exactly how many optimizations are active.
